report: Infant with progressive purplish-red lower-limb mass, MRI enhancing inguinal/thigh vascular mass, and severe consumptive coagulopathy (platelets 18×10^9/L, hypofibrinogenemia, prolonged PT/APTT/TT, D-dimer 21.29, anemia) strongly supports Kasabach-Merritt syndrome. Typical of kaposiform hemangioendothelioma/tufted angioma, likely underlying tumor pending biopsy. Benign tumor, malformation, and malignancy are refuted. Diagnosis: KMS due to KHE/tufted angioma.
